prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1292; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was in a parking lot in League City, Texas, near the entrance to a shopping center. I was pulling into a space near the front row.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had just turned into the lane and was going slowly, maybe five or ten miles an hour. I was looking for an open spot.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?
A: Not clearly. I noticed a car backing out of a space on my right, but I thought it had stopped. Then it rolled back into my front quarter panel.
Q: Were there any witnesses?
A: A woman in the next row came over afterward. I don't know her name, but she said she saw the other car backing up without looking.
Q: How did you feel after the collision?
A: My right wrist hurt right away. I tried to brace the steering wheel and I think that's when I hit it. I was shaken up but able to get out of the car.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon. They took X-rays and told me the wrist was fractured. I've been wearing a splint since.
Q: Have you had any other injuries or prior problems with that wrist?
A: No, I hadn't had any trouble with it before this. It was a healthy wrist.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know?
A: Only that I'm still having trouble gripping things and I have a follow-up appointment with a specialist coming up.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
